posts.title: AI has made Design Systems more important than ever
posts.description: AI is like a paid multiplier. Whatever you put in, gets scaled and amplified. I'm a product manager with a background in Design Systems and accessibility. When it comes to accessibility, there are questions everywhere. For example: "Can AI make accessible websites?", "Can AI make our website accessible?" and "Can AI do accessibility testing?" Systems that hallucinate don't mix well with regulation
